prior_failures.failure: Pretrained CLIP reload differed by max 2.9802322e-08; exact-array gate was inappropriate for native serialization. Subsequent acceptance explicitly requires atol/rtol 1e-6 and reports measured error.
Forwarding use_fast=False via AutoProcessor also selected a slow tokenizer whose vocab files were absent. Fixed by explicitly constructing CLIPImageProcessor and native fast tokenizer separately.

resource_scope: Single CPU host with OMP/BLAS threads=1. Installed pretrained run has Linux single-process getrusage peak; process-tree RAM, hard quotas, energy, GPUs and actual old PCs were not measured in this phase.
